correctness.rationale: For arbitrary x and integer N, choose a directed tail with F containing x and e_(N+1). Source Proposition 4.1 imposes ||(I-P_(m1))|F||<=r<1; if m1<=N then e_(N+1) contradicts this bound. Thus every local lift has zero coordinates in summands 1..N, and the weak-star ultralimit Sx annihilates every finitely supported z in Z=(⊕E_m*)_c0. Density gives PSx=0 for all x, independent of the tail-containing ultrafilter. Since E_m* is finite-dimensional, Z is a c0-sum of reflexive spaces and is M-embedded; its canonical bidual projection is an L-projection, giving ||Sx-J_Yy||=||Sx||+||y||. Isometry of S and norm-one quotient Q yield inf_(Qy=x)||Sx-J_Yy||=2||x||∞. For the equivalent norm max{ε||y||,||Qy||}, Q**(Sx-Jy)=0, and the source bidual norm formula gives 2ε||x||∞. This checks every ε>0 and x including x=0, without claiming a global Λ(Y_ε) equality.
